title: Etale exceptional scalar mate from the inverse compact-support comparison
statement:
Let $C,D$ be commutative rings and $a:C\to D$ a unital ring homomorphism. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes with a compactification $c=(X\hookrightarrow\overline X\to Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use the ordinary unbounded small-etale derived module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and write $S_T:D(T_{\mathrm{et}},C)\to D(T_{\mathrm{et}},D)$ for derived scalar extension along $a$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension]. Put $F_R=Rf_{!,R}^c$ for $R=C,D$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Fix functors $G_R$ with adjunctions $F_R\dashv G_R$ and fix an isomorphism $q:S_YF_C\xrightarrow\sim F_DS_X$. Define
$$b:S_XG_C\longrightarrow G_DS_Y$$
to be the right-adjoint mate of $q^{-1}$. Explicitly, for $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},C)$, $b_K$ is the transpose under $F_D\dashv G_D$ of
$$F_DS_XG_CK\xrightarrow{q^{-1}_{G_CK}}S_YF_CG_CK\xrightarrow{S_Y(\varepsilon_{C,K})}S_YK.$$
This defines the mate for the specified adjunctions and $q$; it asserts no invertibility of $b$ and imposes no flatness or finiteness condition on $a$.
